name: FormatVariantAndSourceEvidence
description: In-memory passive document evidence and the real two-adapter seam.
schema_def: FormatVariantDescriptor {variantId, adapterVersion, extractionPolicyVersion, manifestSchemaVersion, supportedMediaType, hardLimits}
PdfDocumentEvidence {sourceFingerprint, byteLength, ordered pages and glyph values/coordinates/contentOrder}
StatementAccountEvidence {accountId, accountClass, currencyCode, maskedIdentifier, metadataFingerprint, matched}
SourceRecordEvidence {sourceRecordId, pageNumber, recordOrdinal, recordKind, originalTextEvidence, sourceReference?, financialEvidence: FinancialEvidence, runningBalanceMinor?, sourceControlMinor?}
ExtractedStatement {variant, statementPeriod: StatementPeriod, accountEvidence, orderedRecords[], openingEconomicBalanceMinor?, closingEconomicBalanceMinor?, advertisedControls[]}

FinancialEvidence and StatementPeriod reuse the existing INGEST domain contracts. Adapters extract FinancialEvidence without AccountClass sign conversion; preview applies selected AccountDetail.AccountClass through FinancialNormalizer and then passes movements plus extracted controls to StatementReconciler. Layout A rows are anchored by date, amount, and balance columns. A separately rendered description is owned only by the unique transaction vertical midpoint band that contains its description-only visual line; absent or ambiguous ownership blocks extraction. originalTextEvidence joins the anchored row line and an assigned description line in source order. metadataFingerprint is lowercase SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 bytes: adapterVersion, LF, then normalized layout-specific account-metadata fields joined by LF with no trailing LF. Each field uses Unicode FormKC, invariant lowercase, and whitespace collapse. Layout A fields are visual lines in source page/line order containing the case-insensitive marker account or card after monetary-token removal; extraction rejects when no field remains. Paths, filenames, selected accountId, transaction rows, and financial values are excluded. IStatementAdapter exposes Descriptor, Probe(PdfDocumentEvidence), and Extract(PdfDocumentEvidence, exact released AccountDetail). V1 registers exactly two adapters and requires one exact probe match.
